chapter.heading: A Psalm of thanksgiving.
chapter.v:
Make a
joyful noise unto Jehovah, all ye lands.

Serve Jehovah
with gladness:Come before his presence with singing.

Know ye
that Jehovah, he is God:It is he that hath made us, and we are his;We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

Enter into
his gates with thanksgiving,And into his courts with praise:Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.

For Jehovah
is good; his lovingkindness endureth for ever,And his faithfulness unto all generations.
